study_identification_part.si4_title: Resting-State Changes in Aging and Parkinson's Disease Are Shaped by Underlying Neurotransmission: A Normative Modeling Study

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Test whether and how age- and Parkinson's disease–related resting-state changes (fALFF/LCOR/GCOR) colocalize with underlying neurotransmitter systems, and quantify PD deviations from normative aging trajectories.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Age-related resting-state functional changes colocalize with serotonergic, dopaminergic, noradrenergic, and glutamatergic systems. PD shows deviations from normative aging colocalization, notably involving cholinergic and GABAergic systems; GABAA deviation relates to disease duration.
